title: Agent Progression Level Explorer
description: The learner will differentiate the three agent progression levels by placing 8 abilities at the lowest level where each first appears, with at least 7 of 8 correct.
creator: Open Study Buddy
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Study Buddy
chapter_title: Personal Agents and the Open Study Buddy Architecture

educational.topic: Agent progression levels and the swappable brain
learningObjectives: The learner will differentiate the three agent progression levels by placing 8 abilities at the lowest level where each first appears, with at least 7 of 8 correct.

pedagogical.pattern: Placement quiz on a three-level ladder followed by side-by-side comparison of replies
misconceptionsAddressed: A higher level needs a different terminal.
An LLM always gives a correct answer.
pedagogical.assessment: Mastery is 7 of 8 abilities placed at the correct level on the first attempt.
pedagogical.defaultState: Opens at the first item with nothing answered; there is no animation or timer.

controls.label: Level 1 / Level 2 / Level 3
controls.purpose: Part 1: place the current ability; Part 2: show that level's reply

controls.label: Next / Compare replies
controls.purpose: Advance after answering; disabled until an answer is given
